response.original_title: "Living Stones" Christ Church Cathedral. Christchurch New Zealand
response.overview: Christ Church Cathedral, standing in Cathedral Square in the centre of the city of Christchurch is the mother church for Anglicans throughout the Province of Canterbury.  This video tape is a visual record of the interior and exterior of the Cathedral, of its life and activity, and it contains a number of items by the nationally famous Cathedral Choir and by the Bellringers.
